title: Melted Moroccan Cheese Tagine
description: A rich and creamy Moroccan-inspired dish featuring a deep-fried tagine topped with melted cheese.

ingredients.name: Tagine dish
ingredients.notes: Any ceramic or clay tagine dish will work.

ingredients.name: Lamb or beef shoulder
ingredients.notes: You can also use beef or a combination of meats.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality Moroccan olive oil.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion finely and sauté for a richer flavor.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger for added depth.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Use cumin powder for a more intense flavor.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Use sweet paprika for a richer flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for a more refined flavor.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality feta cheese for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Melted mozzarella cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality mozzarella cheese for the best flavor.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine dish over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb or beef shoulder and sear until browned on all sides.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the tagine dish.
Stir well to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine dish and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
While the tagine is cooking, heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add the feta cheese and stir until melted and golden brown.
Add the melted feta cheese to the tagine dish and stir to combine.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and bake at 400°F for 10-15 minutes.
Top the tagine with melted mozzarella cheese and return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
